requirements: lineTotal in basket.mjs returns the line's price times its quantity, so two mugs at 1250 cents give 2500.
lineTotal treats a line with no quantity as a quantity of one, so a line priced 1250 with no quantity gives 1250.
basketTotal returns 0 for an empty basket.
basketTotal returns the sum of the lineTotal of every line, so a basket of two mugs at 1250 cents and one item at 300 cents totals 2800.
Prices and totals stay in cents.
